I’m not able to pull in real‑time data, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what you can expect in Hanoi around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Rainfall (mm) | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|---------------|-------|
| Jan   | 20–22             | 10–12            | 70–90         | Cool, dry, occasional drizzle |
| Feb   | 21–23             | 11–13            | 80–100        | Still cool, some rain |
| Mar   | 23–26             | 14–16            | 120–150       | Warm, rain starts to pick up |
| Apr   | 26–29             | 17–19            | 200–250       | Hot, heavy showers, start of monsoon |
| May   | 28–31             | 19–22            | 300–350       | Very hot, high humidity, frequent rain |
| Jun   | 28–32             | 20–23            | 400–500       | Peak monsoon, heavy rainfall |
| Jul   | 27–31             | 20–23            | 350–450       | Still hot, heavy showers |
| Aug   | 27–31             | 20–23            | 300–400       | Slightly less rain, still humid |
| Sep   | 25–29             | 18–21            | 200–300       | Rain tapers off, still humid |
| Oct   | 22–26             | 15–18            | 120–200       | Cooler, drier, occasional showers |
| Nov   | 18–22             | 12–15            | 80–120        | Mild, dry, cooler nights |
| Dec   | 16–20             | 10–13            | 60–80         | Cool, dry, occasional drizzle |

**Key takeaways**

- **Monsoon season** runs roughly from May to September, with the heaviest rainfall in June–July. Expect short, intense showers and high humidity.
- **Cooler months** (December–February) are drier and more comfortable for outdoor activities, though mornings and evenings can be chilly.
- **Spring** (March–April) is a transition period: temperatures rise, but rainfall starts to increase, especially in April.

If you’re planning a trip or just curious about the current conditions, you might want to check a reliable weather website or app for up‑to‑date forecasts. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the forecast for a specific date!
